aric...@news.acns.nwu.edu (Andrew Richter) writes:
>Hi there,
> I remember once seeing something on this newsgroup that said that a
>retainer's damage cannot be dodged. Is this true? From a physical standpoint
>it would seem to make sense, since you would have a hard time dodging two
>simultaneous attacks, but I couldn't find anything in the rule book about it.

It's pretty well hidden. Damage from a Retainer is not a strike. Dodge
negates a strike. Therefore, dodge does nothing to avoid damage from a
Retainer.

> Oh yeah, one more question: Vast Weath--is the equip action "free,"
>i.e., does it occur during the Master Phase and does it not tap the vampire?

No. Vast Wealth gives the recipient another choice for an action: namely,
(if unblocked) to go through the Library until he finds a weapon. The
"As an action, which would be at +1 stealth" is a clue that it is an action,
not a master phase effect.
